fields.name: Barehipani Waterfall
fields.description: Barehipani Waterfall is one of Odisha’s most spectacular natural attractions, located inside Similipal National Park. It is famous for its magnificent two-tiered cascade, plunging from approximately 399 metres amid dense forests and scenic hills.
fields.location: Similipal National Park, Mayurbhanj, Odisha, India

fields.name: Devkund Waterfall
fields.description: Devkund Waterfall is a beautiful natural attraction in the Similipal region, surrounded by lush green forests and hills. The waterfall flows into a natural pool, and the site is also known for the sacred Maa Ambika Temple located above the falls. It is popular among nature lovers, pilgrims, and photographers.
fields.location: Devkund Road, Damasahi, Mayurbhanj, Odisha, India

fields.name: Malayagiri Hills
fields.description: Malayagiri Hills is a scenic mountain destination in Odisha, known for its high peaks, beautiful valleys, and lush green forests. It offers breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape and attracts trekkers and nature lovers.

fields.name: Satkosia Wildlife Sanctuary
fields.description: Satkosia Wildlife Sanctuary is a beautiful wildlife destination situated along the Mahanadi River. It is famous for its scenic gorge, rich biodiversity, dense forests, and wildlife including elephants, deer, crocodiles, and many species of birds.

fields.name: Ansupa Lake
fields.description: Ansupa Lake is a picturesque freshwater lake surrounded by green hills. It is known for its scenic beauty, boating, fishing, and migratory birds during winter.
fields.location: Ansupa Lake, Banki, Cuttack, Odisha, India

fields.name: Barabati Fort
fields.description: Barabati Fort is a historic fort built during the medieval period. It is known for its ancient stone ruins, moat, and historical significance as a former stronghold of Odisha's rulers.

fields.name: Pradhanpat Waterfall
fields.description: Pradhanpat Waterfall is a beautiful natural attraction surrounded by lush green forests and rocky hills. It is known for its cascading water, peaceful atmosphere, and scenic picnic surroundings.
